title: terrain
description: A map's landform (CONTRACTS/map-authoring-3d.md §1, ADR-0018): unreal/content/terrain/<map>.terrain.json, rendered by tools/ue-bridge/terrain/build_heightmap.py. Frame: SIM METRES — x right, z forward is -z (so +z is toward the camera / the spawn yard on the legacy maps), y up. Every spline point is [x, z] (or [x, z, y] where a kind accepts an authored elevation). Output sample (col, row) sits at (originX + col*resolution, originZ + row*resolution): columns along +x, rows along +z. The Unreal mapping (X = -z*100, Y = x*100, Z = y*100) is applied by the importer, never in these files. 'left' of a spline = the side where (B-A) x (P-A) > 0 in the (x, z) plane, i.e. for a spline travelling toward +z, left is -x.

id.description: Map id (matches maps.json and the level file).

playable.description: [x, z] extent of the playable field in metres, centred on `centre`.

belt.description: Metres of non-playable terrain on every side (containment sits at its inner edge).

centre.description: [x, z] of the playable centre; default [0, 0].

resolution.description: Metres per heightmap sample (default 1.0 = one Landscape quad of 100 cm). Output size is ceil((playable + 2*belt) / resolution) + 1 per axis.

baseElevation.description: Starting elevation (metres) everywhere before any feature.

seed.description: Base seed for noise layers that do not carry their own.

features.description: Applied in ascending `priority` (default 0; ties by array order; noise layers default to 50, so give a feature priority > 50 to apply it after noise). Each is a distance-field blend along `spline` with a `profile` (smooth = smoothstep, sharp = linear, stepped = `steps` treads).

id.description: Optional name; noise masks and the stats block refer to it. Also the mask file name is by kind, not id.

kind.description: ridge/embankment: +height within width/2 of the spline, falling to 0 over `falloff`. valley/cut/saddle: the same, subtracting `depth`. plateau: closed polygon (or centre+radius) blended to `elevation` (absolute) or raised by `height`, with `falloff` outside. basin: closed polygon (or centre+radius) bowl reaching `depth` once `falloff` inside the rim (or blended to `elevation`). terrace/cliff: the ground on `side` of the spline is `height` higher; the face is `width` wide, centred on the line (terrace default width 4 smooth, cliff default width 1 sharp). roadbed: the ground under a lane is flattened across `width` (+ `falloff`) and re-graded along the spline to <= `maxGrade` percent (default 30); bed elevation from [x,z,y] vertices or, when absent, from the terrain as it stands. shore: on `side` (default right) of the line the ground blends to `elevation` over `falloff` and is flat beyond it.

spline.description: Polyline [[x, z], ...] in sim metres; closed polygon for plateau/basin (first point is not repeated); roadbed may use [x, z, y].

centre.description: plateau/basin alternative to a polygon: [x, z] with `radius`.

width.description: Full width in metres of the flat part (ridge/valley/roadbed) or of the step face (terrace/cliff).

falloff.description: Metres over which the blend fades (default: the feature's width, or 4 for regions).

side.description: terrace/cliff: the high side (default left). shore: the bed side (default right).

maxGrade.description: roadbed: maximum grade in percent (default 30, the lane rule).

gradeMode.description: roadbed: how the grade limiter re-profiles a too-steep bed (default balanced).

noise.description: Value noise on a seeded lattice, summed over `octaves` (frequency x `lacunarity`, amplitude x `persistence` per octave), scaled by `amplitude` metres and by the mask.

amplitude.description: Metres; the first octave spans roughly [-amplitude, +amplitude].

frequency.description: Lattice cells per metre (0.05 = a 20 m lattice).

priority.description: Default 50 (after features with the default priority 0).

mask.description: "all" (default), a feature id (that feature's blend weight), or {feature|polygon|region, invert?, falloff?} where region is "playable" or "belt". A feature named here must have a lower priority than this layer.

water.description: Water bodies. They do not change the heightmap (author the bed with basin/shore); the tool writes <map>_mask_water.png where the region is below `level` and lists them in <map>_height.json for the importer.

flats.description: Explicitly flat polygons, applied after every feature and noise layer (they override everything). Each needs a `reason` — flat ground is the exception under ADR-0018.

falloff.description: Metres of smooth blend outside the polygon (default 0 = a hard edge).
